title: Oxford blood donor center adds Monday and Saturday hours for Thanksgiving week
excerpt: The Oxford center is open 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Monday and 9 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. Saturday. Mississippi Blood Services says it especially needs types A, B and O.
locality: Oxford Donor Center in neighboring Lafayette County, a regional option for Pontotoc County residents.

facts.statement: Pontotoc County residents who give blood in Oxford have two extra days to do so this Thanksgiving week. Mississippi Blood Services lists special openings at 2627 West Oxford Loop, Suite C, from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Monday, Nov. 23, and from 9 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 28.
facts.evidence: The official holiday announcement gives both Oxford openings. The location directory independently lists 2627 West Oxford Loop, Suite C.

facts.identities: Mississippi Blood Services and its Oxford Donor Center.

paragraphs.text: Pontotoc County residents who give blood in Oxford have two extra days to do so this Thanksgiving week. Mississippi Blood Services lists special openings at 2627 West Oxford Loop, Suite C, from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Monday, Nov. 23, and from 9 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 28.

The center also opens Tuesday from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Wednesday brings an earlier start and finish, from 7:30 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. It closes for Thanksgiving Day and reopens Friday from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. The Oxford schedule lists Sunday, Nov. 29, and Monday, Nov. 30, as closed.

Mississippi Blood Services says types A, B and O are especially needed. The organization puts its daily collection need at about 250 blood products for hospitals across Mississippi. Its separate appeal for Monday platelet donors encourages people to make an appointment in advance.
Correction, Nov. 23: An earlier version of this story and its graphic misstated the street number. The Oxford center is at 2627 West Oxford Loop, Suite C.
